f.title: Submit 15-day Alert ICSRs, periodic reports and section 760 reports to FDA electronically
f.statement: Under the final rule, the following reports must be submitted to FDA in an electronic format: postmarketing 15-day Alert report ICSRs and any ICSR attachments; periodic adverse (drug) experience reports (including the ICSRs, any ICSR attachments, and the descriptive information portion); and section 760 reports.

f.exceptions: Not covered: IND safety reports, NDA safety update reports, NDA/BLA annual reports, BPDRs, fatal blood transfusion/collection complication reports, HCT/P adverse reaction reports under PHS Act 361, NDA field alert reports (preamble II.B)
f.processes: E2B / transmission; Submission operations; Safety system configuration

f.title: An OTC retailer named as distributor may authorise the manufacturer or packer to submit section 760 reports
f.statement: Under section 760, a retailer whose name appears on the label of a nonprescription drug marketed in the US without an approved application, as a distributor, may, by agreement, authorize the manufacturer or packer of the nonprescription drug to submit the required reports to FDA, as long as the retailer directs to the manufacturer or packer all adverse events associated with the drug that are reported to the retailer.
